records.title: Approximating Latent Manifolds in Neural Networks via Vanishing Ideals
records.reason: The paper studies algebraic approximation of latent manifolds in neural networks using vanishing ideals. It is theoretical representation analysis and reports no inference efficiency or model compression contribution.

records.title: Helping the Weak Makes You Strong: Simple Multi-Task Learning Improves Non-Autoregressive Translators
records.reason: The work uses multi-task learning to strengthen non-autoregressive translation systems and improve generation quality. It inherits parallel decoding’s speed characteristics, but the contribution is training/quality rather than a direct inference-cost method.
